children.description: Description. Stems 1 - 5, 10 - 40 cm, with 1 cauline leaf proximally or near middle. Basal leaves 3 - 7 (10); petiole 2 - 16 cm; blade reniform, cordate or ovate-cordate, 1 - 4 x 1 - 4.5 cm, base deeply cordate to subcordate, apex rounded, apiculate. Flower 2 - 4.5 cm in diam.; hypanthium turbinate or campanulate. Sepals oblong, ovate to obovate, 4 - 13 x 2 - 8 mm, margin entire, apex rounded-obtuse.
